help_main: Welcome! Here is a quick guide: For Employers: 1. Create a job with details & budget 2. Review incoming applications 3. Accept the best freelancer 4. Fund escrow to start work 5. Confirm work to release payment For Freelancers: 1. Browse available jobs 2. Apply with your price & timeframe 3. Wait for acceptance 4. Complete the work 5. Submit for employer review Select a topic below for more details:
help_jobs: 📋 Jobs Guide Creating a Job (Employer): • Go to ➕ Create Job • Fill in title, description, category • Set your budget and deadline • Your job goes live immediately Applying (Freelancer): • Browse 🔍 Find Jobs • Use filters to narrow results • Tap a job → Apply • Enter your price, timeframe & cover letter
help_payments: 💰 Payments Guide Top Up: • Go to 💰 Balance → Top Up • Choose CryptoBot or TON • Follow payment instructions Withdraw: • Go to 💰 Balance → Withdraw • Min. withdrawal: $5 • Processed within 24 hours Platform Fee: • 5% fee on each completed deal • Deducted from the payment to freelancer
help_escrow: 🔒 Escrow System Escrow protects both parties: 1. Employer accepts a freelancer 2. Employer funds escrow (job amount) 3. Funds are held securely on platform 4. Freelancer completes work 5. Employer confirms → funds released ⚠️ If there's a dispute, our team mediates and resolves it fairly.
help_faq: ❓ FAQ Q: Can I change my role? A: Yes, go to Profile → Change Role. Q: What if the employer doesn't confirm? A: Open a dispute. Our team will review. Q: How long do withdrawals take? A: Up to 24 hours. Q: Is my money safe? A: Yes — funds are held in escrow until work is confirmed.
